head: qrš 4
notes: Lu+talgo qrəšle i+arʕo = Lu+talgo mkasele i+arʕo (Ilyas p.c. 13/01/25)

W ánnaqqa u+qalәb̥ste g̊saymíwaynale, quršíwayna ... әmṭíwayna ánnaqqa qaṣmono dat+tanure:  qáṭmoyo, qaṣmono? (Ni ġala 57) And then (first) we made a pattern vessel, we used to put a layer…  we used to bring ashes of tannoor.
